propositions.name: ether_exists
propositions.statement: The undulatory theory of light assumes the existence of a medium called the ether.
propositions.quote: The undulatory theory of light assumes the existence of a medium called the ether, whose vibrations produce the phenomena of heat and light, and which is supposed to fill all space.

propositions.name: fresnel_ether_drag_in_optical_media
propositions.statement: The ether enclosed in optical media partakes of the motion of these media, to an extent depending on their indices of refraction.

propositions.name: air_ether_drag_negligible
propositions.statement: For air, the motion of the ether is but a small fraction of that of the air itself and can be neglected.

propositions.name: ether_at_rest_earth_moves_through_it
propositions.statement: The ether is assumed to be at rest while the earth moves through it.

propositions.name: light_travel_time_depends_on_direction
propositions.statement: Under the assumption that the ether is at rest, the time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface depends on the direction in which it travels.

propositions.name: solar_system_moves_toward_hercules

propositions.name: gradual_change_produces_outstanding_error
propositions.statement: A gradual change in the readings, which should not affect the periodic variation being searched for, would itself necessitate an outstanding error.

propositions.name: no_displacement_of_bands_observed
propositions.statement: The interpretation of the results is that there is no displacement of the interference bands.
propositions.quote: The interpretation of these results is that there is no displacement of the interference bands.

propositions.name: stationary_ether_hypothesis_shown_incorrect
propositions.statement: The result of the hypothesis of a stationary ether is shown to be incorrect, and the hypothesis is erroneous.
propositions.quote: The result of the hypothesis of a stationary ether is thus shown to be incorrect, and the necessary conclusion follows that the hypothesis is erroneous.

propositions.name: aberration_presupposes_earth_moving_through_ether
propositions.statement: The explanation of aberration presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the ether remaining at rest.
propositions.quote: This conclusion directly contradicts the explanation of the phenomenon of aberration which has been hitherto generally accepted, and which presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the latter remaining at rest.

propositions.name: two_theories_of_aberration_run_parallel
propositions.statement: Two totally different theories can run parallel to each other in the explanation of the phenomena of aberration.
propositions.quote: This affords a curious instance of two totally different theories running parallel to each other in the explanation of phenomena.

propositions.name: ether_may_not_move_freely_through_earth
propositions.statement: It is not to be believed, without good evidence, that the ether moved quite freely through the solid mass of the earth.
propositions.quote: we would not be disposed to believe, without good evidence, that the ether moved quite freely through the solid mass of the earth
